TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Traffic regulation will be in place in Paharganj area from 10.04.2026 to 12.04.2026 due to Annual Satsang (Ijtema) at Shahi Idgah, Sadar Bazar.

A large gathering of approx. 50,000 devotees is expected daily.

TIME: 08:00 AM – 08:00 PM

📍Final dispersal will take place on 12.04.2026 after 10:00 PM

📍 Likely Affected Stretches:
* Rani Jhansi Road
* R.K. Marg
* R/A Eidgah & adjoining areas

📍 Use alternate route via Faiz Road

📍 Plan your journey in advance to avoid inconvenience

📍 Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels

#DPTrafficAdvisory
